MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt']
WITH p.position AS position, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS lowest_medals
RETURN position AS col1, lowest_medals AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH CASE
  WHEN p.position IN ['Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Frontcourt'] THEN 'Frontcourt'
  WHEN p.position IN ['Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Backcourt'] THEN 'Backcourt'
  ELSE NULL
END AS position, p
WHERE position IS NOT NULL
RETURN position AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2
